d:
The Philippines has more than 7,500 islands, and today I'm taking you to the narrowest inhabited one: Bilangbilangan! I found it by randomly zooming in on Google Maps and got so curious that I hired a boat for a 5-hour ride out there. I showed up unannounced and filmed the whole experience. It proved once again that Filipinos are some of the most welcoming people in the world :)
I wrote a book called JUST GO, with exclusive travel stories & tips to inspire your next adventures!
